{{Quote|Attention ''Jade Shadow''. This is the ''Black Wave''. Enter a parking orbit and cease all attempts to leave the Dathomir system or we will be forced to open fire.|Sarasu Taalon|<ref name="lash" />}}
The '''''Black Wave''''' was a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]-produced [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. It was a part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]], and was commanded by [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]. In [[43 ABY]], the ''Black Wave'' was among the ChaseMasters taken to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in order to confront [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and convince him to join the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in an [[Mission to the Maw|alliance]] to eliminate [[Abeloth]]. After Taalon's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|battle]] on [[Pydyr]], the vessel fell under [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]]'s command. In [[44 ABY]], when Abeloth [[Destruction of Tahv|attacked]] the Sith [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]], Khai commanded the ''Black Wave'' to [[Abeloth's fleet|support]] Abeloth.
